newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Patterson EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Patterson EPS view raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it had raised its estimate for Patterson Dental Co's fiscal 1998 earnings to $1.91 a share from $1.85.
-- It left its fiscal 1997 estimate of $1.52 a share unchanged.
-- EVEREN said its previous revenue estimates for Colwell Systems, which Patterson has acquired, were conservative. It said it sees additional growth potential as a result of the acquisition.
-- Based on the estimate increase, EVEREN said it also raised its target prices on the stock, to $40 for the near term, up from $38, and to $45 for the long term, up from $43.
-- Shares of Patterson traded up 15/16 to 35-1/8.
